caption:
Manufacturing businesses often need substantial equipment investment alongside working capital to cover raw materials purchased well ahead of finished goods being sold. Equipment finance and working capital facilities are commonly used together here.

Machinery investment and long production cycles both shape how manufacturing businesses manage finance.
